title: 无题（昨夜星辰昨夜风）
titleEn: Untitled (Last Night’s Stars, Last Night’s Wind)
author: 李商隐
intro: The morning after a party, the poet remembers a woman he could only exchange glances with: “No phoenix wings to fly to you, but our hearts, like the rhino’s horn, are linked by a single thread.” Then the drum sounds, and he must hurry off to work.
analysis: 李商隐有许多诗不起题目，叫“无题”，大多写说不出口的爱情。这首诗回忆昨夜的一次宴会。开头连用两个“昨夜”，星辰和夜风，画楼西边、桂堂东边，都是那个夜晚难忘的细节。第三、四句是千古名句：我身上没有彩凤那样的翅膀，不能飞到你身边；可我们的心像灵犀一样，一点就通。传说犀牛角中间有一条白纹贯通两头，所以用“灵犀”比喻心意相通。今天汉语里还说“心有灵犀一点通”。第五、六句写宴会上的游戏：隔着座位传钩、分组猜谜，春酒温暖，灯火通红，热闹极了。最后两句急转：可惜听到更鼓，我得去官署上班，骑马赶去兰台，像风里的蓬草一样身不由己。热闹的回忆和无奈的现实对比，相思更显得深长。
analysisEn: Li Shangyin left many poems without titles, simply called “Untitled”; most are about love that could not be spoken openly. This one recalls a party the night before. The opening repeats “last night” twice — the stars, the wind, the painted tower to the west, the cassia hall to the east — the kind of details you remember when an evening mattered. The second couplet is among the most quoted lines in Chinese: I have no bright phoenix wings to fly to you, yet our hearts, like the magic rhinoceros horn, connect at a single point. People believed a white thread ran straight through the centre of a rhino horn, so 灵犀 lingxi came to mean two hearts that understand each other without words; 心有灵犀一点通 is still used today. The third couplet shows the party games: passing a hidden hook across the table, guessing hidden objects in teams, warm spring wine, red candlelight. Then the last couplet turns suddenly. Alas, the drum announces the hour, and he must report for duty, riding off to the palace library like tumbleweed blown by the wind. The bright memory set against dull duty makes the longing all the deeper.
background: Li Shangyin (c. 813–858) was one of the great poets of the late Tang, famous for dense, beautiful and often mysterious verse. Caught between two rival court factions, he spent most of his life in minor posts. The “Orchid Terrace” at the end refers to the imperial library, where he served as a junior editor around 839; the identity of the woman, if there was one, is unknown.
pronunciation: 应官 yìng guān（应差上班，不读 yīng）；射覆 shè fù；嗟 jiē；曹 cáo。
version: 采用通行本，原题二首，此为第一首（另一首为七绝“闻道阊门萼绿华”）。异文：“画楼”一作“画堂”，“类转蓬”一作“类断蓬”。

lines.py: zuó yè xīng chén zuó yè fēng
lines.lit: Last night’s stars, last night’s wind,
lines.en: Last night’s stars, last night’s breeze —

lines.py: huà lóu xī pàn guì táng dōng
lines.lit: west of the painted tower, east of the cassia hall.
lines.en: west of the painted tower, east of the cassia hall.

lines.py: shēn wú cǎi fèng shuāng fēi yì
lines.lit: My body lacks the bright phoenix’s pair of flying wings;
lines.en: I have no phoenix wings to fly to you,

lines.py: xīn yǒu líng xī yī diǎn tōng
lines.lit: our hearts have the magic rhino horn, joined at one point.
lines.en: but like the rhino’s horn, our hearts are joined by one bright thread.

lines.py: gé zuò sòng gōu chūn jiǔ nuǎn
lines.lit: Across the seats we pass the hook, the spring wine is warm;
lines.en: Passing the hidden hook across the table, the spring wine warm,

lines.py: fēn cáo shè fù là dēng hóng
lines.lit: in teams we guess what’s covered, the candles are red.
lines.en: guessing in teams what lies under the cup, the candles glowing red.

lines.py: jiē yú tīng gǔ yìng guān qù
lines.lit: Alas, I hear the drum and go to answer my office;
lines.en: Alas — the drum sounds, and I must go to work,

lines.py: zǒu mǎ lán tái lèi zhuǎn péng
lines.lit: riding to the Orchid Terrace, like a whirling tumbleweed.
lines.en: riding to the library like tumbleweed blown in the wind.

words.note: 李商隐常用的诗题，多写爱情。
书面语，现代汉语说“星星”。

words.py: xīn yǒu língxī yī diǎn tōng
words.en: hearts that understand each other without words
words.note: 今天仍是常用俗语，形容默契。

words.en: a party game: passing a hidden hook
words.note: 古代酒宴游戏，猜钩在谁手里。

words.en: a guessing game: what is hidden under the cup
words.note: 射：猜；覆：盖。和今天“射箭”的“射”不同。

words.en: the Orchid Terrace — the imperial library
words.note: 唐代指秘书省，李商隐在那里做校书郎。
古义，现代汉语说“像”，成语“画虎类犬”。
比喻漂泊不定、身不由己。

imagery.name: 星
imagery.zh: 开头重复“昨夜”，星辰和风把人带回那个难忘的夜晚。
imagery.en: “Last night” said twice: stars and wind carry him back to an unforgettable evening.

imagery.name: 凤
imagery.zh: 彩凤能双双飞去，人却没有翅膀，不能飞到对方身边。
imagery.en: Phoenixes fly in pairs, but he has no wings to fly to her side.

imagery.name: 灯
imagery.zh: 宴会上的蜡灯通红，热闹温暖，和后面匆匆离去形成对比。
imagery.en: Red candlelight at the party glows warm and bright, in contrast to his hurried departure.
